Definitions

by any modality.

Parity

SERVICE PARITY

An invented plan must cover a service given by telehealth.

It may not ask for an in-person visit first.

SOURCE: ZZ Statute 200.1 (4). & 200.2. (Accessed Mar. 2026).

Live Video

POLICY

Avalon Medicaid pays for live video visits.

  • The visit must be two-way.
  • The visit must be in real time.

SOURCE: ZZ Admin Code 59-1. (Accessed Mar 2026 ).

Hospital at Home

Patients in an invented home program may be seen by video.

SOURCE: ZZ Medicaid, Alert 7.
